svg.title: Ashen Frontier — The Cinder Basin: precise region blueprint
svg.desc: Three kilometer square inland post-apocalyptic region. Southwest starter area, western exploration loop, north forest, east dam and quarry, southeast factory. Coordinates are meters, north is up.
svg.text: Stylized survival region · 3 × 3 km · Unity / URP · free-first art direction
A warm outpost. A flooded town. A dead rail yard.
Follow broken infrastructure into the ash zone.
600 × 600 m. One battery. Two walkable routes.
Establish scale, movement and one art sample.
Then expand into the surrounding nine tiles.
Risk rises from amber to rust
Low-poly forms, exposed repairs, charred pines.
Keep saturated warmth around occupied spaces.
Grid: nine 1 km planning tiles, A1–C3
BLUEPRINT / heights and meshes are separate build tasks.
DESIGN CONCEPT · NOT A UNITY BUILD
